frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
frontmatter.excerpt: The Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) is a crucial framework that guides software development teams in creating high-quality, functional, and user-friendly software. It's a well-defined, systematic approach to the various stages involved in software development, ensuring that the final product meets the users' requirements and expectations. In this blog post, we will explore the different stages of the SDLC, highlighting the importance of each step in the process.
frontmatter.title: An Introduction to the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC): A Comprehensive Overview
